scope: Reviewed OMAI formula endpoints and exact Lean proof source. Hash and compiled-name checks detect drift and provenance errors; they are not automatic symbolic translation or numerical validation.
interpretations: compute_qha_gibbs is the infimum over an open volume window of F(T,V)+pV, with F the actual molar Helmholtz surface of the static-plus-harmonic ensembles and x=(T,p).
compute_heat_capacity_p is -T*(d2G/dT2)_p of that Gibbs energy; compute_thermal_expansion is (dV/dT)_p/V with V=(dG/dp)_T; compute_bulk_modulus_qha is V*(d2F/dV2)_T at the volume (dG/dp)_T.
contract_thermal_gruneisen is the mean of supplied mode parameters weighted by actual Physlib canonical heat capacities of supplied oscillators.

The producers read the Gibbs surface G for V, alpha_V and C_P, and the free-energy curvature F_VV at the volume dG/dp for K_T, the faithful mirror of the Phonopy EOS B0. The closure check is syntactic: for K_T and the Gamma contraction it shows only a different spelling of V*F_VV and of the existing weighted mean, not an independent route.

The identifications hold on a local stable equilibrium family for any open window across which F+pV is convex, and for every sufficiently narrow window. BulkModulus is an output association of compute_bulk_modulus_qha, not a proof subject. Numerical volume scans, EOS fits, minimizers, FC3 and finite-difference Gruneisen producers and Phonopy are not verified.
